providers.resourceIndex: Actual declared opaque header plus 32 typed entry pointers; caller supplies genuine declared component objects
providers.storage: Ordinary C, deterministic aligned subspans of a single physically backed U32 arena; not the original game allocator
providers.callback: void *(U32,U32,U32,U32), invoked as exact typed C; no register-return hooks
providers.callbackDomain: May observe initialized resource/context state. Cannot reenter or mutate controller-owned inputs during the call.
providers.headerTable: 189 caller-provided U32 command headers; production initializer unrecovered
providers.categories: The 193 initialized-data list words are independently reconstructed and compared byte-for-byte with the measured image defaults
providers.globalInitialization: Actual complete game global/context/resource initialization is outside this packet

memoryContract: Mask, selection/cache/context, resource records, immutable shader/constant inputs and output are properly backed declared component objects
Native CPU pointers remain full width. Physical/device address tokens remain separate U32 words; they are not native pointers
Opaque U32 cells used only as presence/address tokens are provisioned as such; no complete native game-owner cast is supported
All typed pointers obey their actual natural alignment; no packed-member pointer escape
Fixed/incrementing even-count writers physically read the extra backed U32 padding word; no implicit zero substitution for caller buffers
The main logical output limit can be exceeded by one U32 after a soft pair write; physical output backing includes that word
Controller temporary table storage is one genuine 513-word span initialized zero; shared scratch reuse is preserved

floating.profile: IEEE binary32, nearest-even arithmetic, no FZ/DAZ or trapped floating exceptions, no fused contraction
floating.floatToUnsigned: Explicit finite/clamped/saturating conversion ranges; no undefined out-of-range C cast
floating.status: Raw VFP/FPSCR, FPCR/FPSR and Windows MXCSR observations retained; cross-backend floating-status equality not claimed
floating.windowsHarness: Clears only exception status for the measured call and restores the saved caller mode before model checks

rawDifferences.callerStackPadding: Actual caller stack words may enter command alignment padding; six seeded audits retain raw differences
rawDifferences.comparison: Only a post-execution decoder view compares packet headers/parameters. No executed memory/register/code/literal is rewritten.

limits: Single-threaded nonvolatile initialized storage; asynchronous/raw dead-stack observers excluded
OOM, invalid service pointers, malformed cache graphs and invalid/unbacked ranges unsupported
Buffer/constant attribute totals above 12 take the measured fallback path; compact descriptor invariants apply only to admitted <=12-slot storage
No actual GPU, original hardware, Android OS/device, whole-game, exact object matching or source-credit claim
